instructorsData.name: Mikael
instructorsData.bio: Mikael has been dancing for over 12 years with a focus on bachata and is the founder of Fuego Dance School. With a background as a PE teacher and Thai boxing instructor, he teaches clearly, structurally, and always with a focus on safety and technique in partner dancing.
instructorsData.experience: 7+ years of dance teaching and 9 years as a Thai boxing instructor
specialties: Safety and security in partner dance
achievements: 1.5 years mentorship with Bachata Sensual founders Korke & Judith
Certified Bachata Sensual Level 1 and 2 instructor training

instructorsData.name: Irina
instructorsData.bio: Irina has been dancing since she was 5 years old: ballet, ballroom, and latin dance. She has been teaching bachata since 2017 and is a co-founder of Fuego Dance School. With a background as an experienced dancer and teacher in daily life, Irina places great emphasis on basics and technique.
instructorsData.experience: 8+ years of dance teaching and 9+ as a teacher
achievements: 1.5 years mentorship with Bachata Sensual founders Korke & Judith

instructorsData.name: Sisco
instructorsData.focus: Technique, body understanding and role rotation
instructorsData.bio: With over 20 years of experience from the training and coaching world, Sisco has a deep understanding of the body in motion. With humor and clear feedback, he coaches students to become safe, stable dancers. By leading, following, and role-rotating, he gives students a holistic understanding of the dance.
instructorsData.experience: 7+ years of experience in bachata, 20+ years in sports coaching
specialties: Biomechanics, body awareness and basic technique
achievements: Certified Bachata Sensual Level 1 instructor training
Under mentorship of the founders of Role Rotation – Felipe & Tiago
Ongoing ballet training for technique and body control

instructorsData.name: Tomas
instructorsData.bio: Tomas combines dance psychology, musicality, and technique to create clear and safe communication in partner dancing. His teaching is based on effective development, flow, and social safety on the dance floor.
achievements: Certifications in: Musicality in Ballet, Mental Skills for Dancers, Intro to Teaching, Effective Training for Dancers, Dance Psychology, Anatomy for Dancers
Competition and show experience at social-focused events in the Nordics
Active instructor at Fuego Dance School and booked for workshops around Sweden

instructorsData.name: Nora
instructorsData.focus: Role rotation, dance communication and creativity
instructorsData.bio: Nora started dancing bachata while living in Barcelona in 2017. With a background in norm-critical social work, she teaches with soft clarity and a focus on safety and interplay. By switching between leading and following roles, she gives students a holistic view and a deeper understanding of the dance.
instructorsData.experience: 8+ years of experience in bachata, 10+ years of dance experience in other styles
achievements: Certified Bachata Sensual Level 1 instructor training
Under mentorship of the founders of Role Rotation – Felipe & Tiago
Certifications in Dance Psychology, Anatomy and Teaching
Ongoing ballet training for technique and body control

instructorsData.name: Lisa
instructorsData.bio: Lisa has trained in bachata for over a year, but dance has always been a part of her life. Originally from France, she grew up exploring different styles, especially Afro dance, and now loves sharing the joy of bachata in a safe and inclusive space like Fuego.
instructorsData.experience: 1.5 years of bachata training and social dancing, with lifelong personal experience in dance
specialties: Communication and comfort in partner work
achievements: Lifelong background in various dance styles

instructorsData.name: Johanna
instructorsData.focus: Bachata Sensual, Social dancing, Solo dance
instructorsData.bio: Johanna found bachata two years ago and has since focused heavily on developing her technique and creativity. As a trained physiotherapist, she looks forward to supporting dancers in developing in a way that both feels good and looks good.
instructorsData.experience: 10+ years of dance experience in various styles
achievements: Contemporary dance education, 1 semester, Danceworks Berlin
